dct_title_s: King County, Washington : Metro revenue service footprint
dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington King County Metro route footprint. A portion of the scheduled operation of a transit vehicle that is advertised in public timetables as available for public transportation service. Includes Ride Free Area service.

Purpose: Used by transit staff and systems to represent the scheduled path of transit routes in the system. This layer is used for planning and operations in a variety of information systems including vehicle location; passenger counting; customer information and service planning.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
